# Joaquín Martín Presents the Nomadar and Cádiz CF Ecosystem at LD Micro


by[Press](https://nomadar.com/author/press/)


| Nov 20, 2026


|[News](https://nomadar.com/category/news/) |[0 comments](https://nomadar.com/joaquin-martin-presents-the-nomadar-and-cadiz-cf-ecosystem-at-ld-micro/#respond)


Joaquín Martín, CEO Americas of Nomadar (Nasdaq: NOMA), took part in the LD Micro Main Event in Los Angeles, where he talked with CEO Sessions, from The Money Channel, about the vision, growth, and international expansion of Nomadar and Cádiz CF. There he explained how sports, tourism, health, and technology come together in one project.


During the interview, several topics came up, such as the HPT (High Performance Training) program, as well as the important role technology and artificial intelligence play in player performance. The interview also covered sports tourism, which Nomadar promotes with events like the Cádiz Global Cup tournament; the company’s international presence; and its growth plans, which include new sports.


Watch the full interview and discover where Nomadar is headed:[https://youtu.be/pMcsrVrxuUU?si=yx54G3_wMqaMjAie](https://youtu.be/pMcsrVrxuUU?si=yx54G3_wMqaMjAie) .
